initial_state: Live prediction scoring endpoint (/score-transaction, /transactions/score, /predict/score) receiving real-time transaction scoring request.
fault_order_injected: Serving model forward pass raises unexpected exception (e.g. CUDA OOM, PyTorch tensor dimension mismatch, runtime crash) during _eval_model.
expected_invariant: SYS-INV-05 (Failure Does Not Become Success): A failure in an authoritative stage must not be converted downstream into a plausible successful business outcome. The endpoint must propagate HTTP 500 error truthfully.
actual_result: In backend/app/presentation/routers/predict.py lines 977-984, the exception was caught and swallowed, falling back to a hardcoded fabricated ml_prediction = 0.15, returning HTTP 200 with an artificial risk score.
first_divergence: backend/app/presentation/routers/predict.py:981 where except Exception caught the model evaluation failure and assigned ml_prediction = 0.15 instead of raising HTTPException.
root_cause: Permissive silent fallback in score_transaction designed to mask model crashes, violating truthful failure propagation contract.
business_security_impact: High-risk fraudulent transactions occurring during transient ML model memory exhaustion or crashes would be assigned a low fraud score (0.15), bypassed from fraud review, and erroneously approved as legitimate transactions.
repair: Replaced the swallowed exception fallback with a strict fail-closed HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f'Inference pipeline execution error: {exc}'), guaranteeing truthful failure propagation across all serving routes.
